content:
sam-sales: quick sync — DeltaCorp POC reporting missing trace IDs after we started HEC export. Also saw intermittent 429s during their load test. Need a short triage.

talia-eng: can you include a raw exported JSON event + their forwarder config? 429s may be backpressure or huge batches.

sam-sales: customer posted decrypted event: ```json
{
  "time":1700001000,
  "event":{"request_id":"r-900","trace":{"id":"tr-900","span":"s1"},"msg":"ok"}
}
```
and their forwarder config: ```yaml
exporter: splunk-hec
batch_size: 100
flatten: true
```

ryan-sre: flatten:true likely turned trace object into a dotted key ("trace.id") that some HEC pipelines drop. Also large batches + retries can produce 429 bursts.

talia-eng: short-term ask them to set batch_size: 10 and flatten: false. Long-term: we can offer a per-POC transform to rename dotted keys to underscored names.

sam-sales: customer prefers us to handle transform on our side. Can you provide a minimal mapping we can enable for the POC?

ryan-sre: example mapping to apply in exporter canary: ```json
{"mappings":[{"from":"trace.id","to":"trace_id"},{"from":"trace.span","to":"span_id"}]}
```

opsbot: Canary deploy started: export-field-mapper @eng-runtime build#4201

sam-sales: shared mapping with customer — they reported trace_id immediately visible in Splunk. They still saw 3x 429s during a 15k QPS spike but dropped after we suggested lowering concurrency and adding exponential backoff.

opsbot: Canary deploy success — 2 instances healthy. Metrics: delta-poc.429_count=3

ryan-sre: follow-ups: 1) prod-ize field-mapper and docs, 2) add per-tenant 429 counter to Console, 3) add Splunk HEC recommended settings to POC playbook (batch_size 10-20, disable flattening).

sam-sales: great work — DeltaCorp happy with the quick fix. Closing unless they reopen. :thumbsup>
